scope: Optical bench concept illustration, planar CAD signal routing and rotated instrument experiment
decision: Keep named logical connections and exact coordinates in the source drawing. Generate the SVG, DXF and illustrative image brief from that model. Keep the optional raster reference attributed separately.
rotation_observation: Two 45-degree synthetic benches have intersecting enclosing boxes and zero solid volume in common. A positive-overlap control and a vertically separated control also matched their preregistered outcomes.
limits: Image concept illustrated via external generation in this review. No runtime image-provider endpoint qualifier. A reference image does not establish topology. Geometric routing models single-plane signals only. Rotated solids are an experiment; the production spatial critic remains axis-aligned.
next_actions: Implement yaw-aware collision checks and transformed service envelopes against the frozen CAD oracle before enabling rotated layouts.
Exercise the versioned image brief through a qualified image-provider adapter and record the model, source digest and generated asset digest on the same run.
